content.summary: Bedding and comfort retailer Purple (NASDAQ:PRPL) missed Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales flat year on year at $118.8 million. On the other hand, the company’s full-year revenue guidance of $475 million at the midpoint came in 0.6% above analysts’ estimates.
